sections.title: Network
instructions: 2. Make sure your phone and PC are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
3. Scan the QR code at the top right with your phone.
4. The QR code opens the Iris pairing page on your phone.
5. Set a Panel password below, then enter it on your phone to pair the device.
iPhone / iPad: Open the pairing page in Safari. For quick access, tap Share → Add to Home Screen to install Iris as a PWA.
Android: You can use Iris in Chrome and add it to your Home Screen as a PWA, or use the Iris Android app (APK) if provided.
Your phone will remain paired until you revoke it under Manage devices.

Connection lost? Your router may have assigned the PC a new IP address through DHCP. For the most reliable connection, reserve the Iris PC's current IP address as a static/DHCP-reserved address in your router. You don't need to change anything in Iris.
If the connection drops or the address changes, simply scan the QR code again to reconnect using the current address.

Security notice: The local Iris connection uses HTTP rather than HTTPS. Your phone may therefore display a "connection isn't secure" warning. This is expected when connecting to Iris directly over your local network.
